ValidationRule.description: Prevent updating parent opp with Approved Pricing / FinOps
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $User.Bypass_VR__c = FALSE, $Profile.Name!='Xendit API Profile', RecordType.Name = 'Child Opportunity', OR( ISNEW(), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), PRIORVALUE(Parent_Opportunity__c) != Parent_Opportunity__c ) ), NOT(ISBLANK( Parent_Opportunity__c )), OR( TEXT(Parent_Opportunity__r.Pricing_Approval__c) = "Approved", TEXT(Parent_Opportunity__r.Fin_Opp_Approval__c) = "Approved" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to assign the Opportunity to Parent with Approved Pricing or Approved FinOps
